business_scope.primary_industry_name: Real Estate Property Management and Rental Screening Cloud

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Colombia–Spain Bilateral Investment Treaty (2007, in force 2010)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law 1258 of 2008 (SAS); Decreto 410 de 1971 (Código de Comercio); Law 526 of 1999 and Law 1121 of 2006 (AML/CFT framework); Decreto 830 de 2021 and Resolución DIAN 164 de 2021 (RUBF – Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales); External Circular 008 de 2019 (SAGRILAFT, Superintendencia de Sociedades); Ley 2195 de 2022 (anti-corruption and asset tracing).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney (Poder Especial) granted by each founding shareholder or corporate representative for execution of the incorporation act and registration filings
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the shareholder's jurisdiction of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation, Good Standing and Corporate Powers of any foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry or competent commercial authority in the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of the passport or national identity document of each ultimate beneficial owner and legal representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary or competent authority in the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Source of Funds Declaration and AML warranty letter (Declaración de origen de fondos) accompanying the initial capital contribution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notarized before a notary in the shareholder's origin jurisdiction or before a Colombian consular officer

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Tax residence certificate of each non-resident shareholder for tax treaty entitlement under applicable DTAA
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Domestic tax authority of the shareholder's residence country

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory multi-list screening of all shareholders, legal representatives and ultimate beneficial owners against the UIAF PEP registry, OFAC Lista Clinton and SDN list, UN Security Council consolidated sanctions, EU consolidated list, and applicable local judicial and administrative sanctions lists. Screening must be completed during pre-incorporation customer due diligence, evidenced in the SAGRILAFT file, and refreshed continuously after incorporation.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) via the Confecámaras network, principally the Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá (www.ccb.org.co and www.rues.org.co)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All corporate acts and RUES filings must be in Spanish; trade names may contain Latin-script foreign words, but every registration filing requires Spanish or a certified Spanish translation. Accented Spanish orthography is preserved and the name must be identical across the certificate of homonymy (certificado de homonimia), by-laws and all subsequent registry filings.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A rejected name may be appealed by filing a recurso de reposición before the issuing Chamber of Commerce within 10 working days, attaching a revised name proposal; the Chamber then remits the file to the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC) for a recurso de apelación, which must be resolved within 15 working days. Applicants may also request a comparative RUES search and a written legal concept from the SIC on distinctiveness; a fresh homonimia certificate may be requested within the reservation window without ministerial approval.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted_with_Limitations - a virtual or legal address is acceptable for a knowledge-based PropTech SAS provided the address is physically locatable, capable of receiving service of process and registry notices, and is declared as the principal domicile in the by-laws; a home-office registered at the legal representative's residence is commonly employed.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 2% annual probability for a Low_Risk_Standard software entity; unannounced on-site inspections by the Chamber of Commerce or supervisory authorities are rare absent AML, tax or consumer-protection red flags.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Homonimia (name clearance) certificate issued through RUES
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá / Confecámaras

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarial preparation and execution of the incorporation act (Acta de constitución)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Notarial fee schedule per Decree 626 of 2007

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Chamber of Commerce pre-registration filing and RUES administrative form
UBO/RUBF pre-registration preparation and submission to DIAN
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille certification of four foreign-origin notarized documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Competent apostille authority in each country of origin (e.g., Ministry of Foreign Affairs)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Per-document apostille tariff, approximately USD 15 per document

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified Spanish translation of apostilled foreign documents
AML/CFT pre-incorporation due diligence, SAGRILAFT manual skeleton and PEP/Sanctions screening report
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for low-risk software service entities

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Corporate legal structuring opinion and SAS by-law draft review
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market hourly or flat-fee benchmark

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Virtual registered office address verification and service-of-process arrangement
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Annual service benchmark for PropTech SaaS entities

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada), arts. 1, 4, 5, 11, 14, 25 and 44; Código de Comercio (Decreto 410 de 1971), arts. 98-113 and 137-156; Decreto 1074 de 2015, arts. 2.2.1.1.1-2.2.1.9.1; Ley 1429 de 2010, arts. 50-53 (registration formalities simplification); Decreto 1625 de 2016, art. 1.6.1.1.1 (tax registration and RUT rules).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the registered-office district operating through the Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) portal, with regulatory oversight by the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución - private incorporation document executed by the founding shareholder(s) and filed for registration with the Chamber of Commerce; if the subscription is paid with real property, the instrument must be elevated to public deed before a Notaría.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum subscribed or paid-up share capital (art. 5, Ley 1258 de 2008); if paid in instalments, the full payment term may not exceed two years from incorporation (art. 14). No escrow or capital deposit account is legally required for cash subscriptions; however, a bank deposit certificate evidencing paid capital and an expert appraisal for non-cash contributions must be annexed whenever the company obtains bank financing or transfers shares.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF THE FOUNDING SHAREHOLDER OF [COMPANY NAME] S.A.S. WHEREAS the subscribing shareholder adopted the bylaws under Law 1258 of 2008, BE IT RESOLVED: 1. All share subscriptions in the Articles of Association are ratified and issued. 2. The Company's registered office is adopted at the address to be recorded in the Commercial Registry; any later change shall be filed through the Cámara de Comercio. 3. [FULL NAME], holder of ID [NUMBER], is appointed Legal Representative with powers over contracts, bank mandates, employment, and registration filings. 4. The Legal Representative is instructed to execute the incorporation registration, pay all registry tariffs, and obtain the DIAN tax registry. Adopted and signed in [CITY], Colombia, this [DAY] of [MONTH], [YEAR].

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name verification and homonymy reservation (pre-verificación de homonimia)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) online portal and the Cámara de Comercio of the registered-office district
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Enter the RUES portal (www.rues.org.co) or attend the Chamber of Commerce counter; submit three alternative corporate names in order of preference for the S.A.S.; the system consults the national commercial registry to certify that no identical or confusingly similar name already exists, entitling the applicant to a homonymy reservation certificate valid for 30 calendar days.
required_dossiers: Original ID document (cédula) of the founding shareholder
CUR/TIN of the legal representative if already appointed
List of up to three proposed corporate names
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the authority objects for homonymy or similarity, immediately repeat the pre-verification with three alternative names; no fee refund is due, and the applicant may also appeal the negative pronouncement under Decreto 1074 de 2015, art. 2.2.1.1.4, without staying parallel re-submission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting, execution and, where required, notarial authentication of the incorporation instrument
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Founding shareholder(s) and, for real-property contributions or requested formality, a Notaría (Notary Public) in the same registry district
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the private incorporation document and complete bylaws: corporate name, indefinite duration, corporate purpose expressly covering the PropTech SaaS business (ISIC 6201: software development, real-estate property-management platforms, rental screening, data analytics), registered office, subscribed and paid capital table, classes and voting rights of shares, governance and representation clauses, and liquidation rules. Execute signatures before a notary only if the law requires or if the shareholders elect public-deed formality.
required_dossiers: Identification of each founding shareholder (physical or legal person)
Draft of the Documento Privado de Constitución with full bylaws
TIN/RUT of each founding shareholder (if already existent)
Power of attorney if the shareholder is represented
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Upon a formal objection from the registry, rectify the private document by means of a bylaws amendment (Reforma Estatutaria) and re-execute signatures; clarification of the original instrument may be filed as an 'aclaración' before the main registration is approved.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Integrated fiscal pre-registration with DIAN via the RUES single window
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN - Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales, through the RUES Ventanilla Única de Registro
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the integrated registration form in RUES providing basic taxpayer information; select the S.A.S. entity type, legal representative data, and the precise CIIU economic activity code 6201 (software computer programming) with the PropTech description; choose the general regime (income tax) and request VAT registry, or elect the Régimen Simple de Tributación if turnover thresholds are met; DIAN pre-approves and issues a provisional NIT used for the commercial registration process.
required_dossiers: Execution instrument of the S.A.S. private document
Identity document of the legal representative
Valid e-mail address and mobile number for tax notifications
Complete information on the economic activity code CIIU 6201
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN issues a correction requirement, submit a 'RUT complementario' or 'corrección de RUT' electronically within the indicated term; for persistent inconsistencies, request a DIAN service-point appointment with the Chamber's certificate of pre-approval.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Payment of the Superintendencia register duties and the Chamber of Commerce administrative tariff
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio collection window or authorized banking entities (recaudo bancario)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Pay the SIC registration fee (derechos de inscripción) and the Chamber of Commerce administrative tariff computed on the subscribed capital base; obtain the pay-in receipt and preserve the transaction ID; payment must be evidenced before the registration application can be adjudicated.
required_dossiers: Pre-approval voucher from RUES (Ventanilla Única)
Provisional NIT/RUT pre-assigned by DIAN
Pay-in slip (recibo de pago) for registry fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Fees erroneously paid can be offset or reimbursed by the Chamber within 30 days under Código de Comercio art. 96 and internal tariff regulations; keep both the original payment voucher and the Chamber's generated payment application for reconciliation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission and adjudication of the incorporation registration at the Chamber of Commerce
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio corresponding to the registered office (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the executed private incorporation document, proof of fee payment, pre-RUT and ID documents at the Chamber window or upload through the RUES digital circuit; the Chamber verifies the legality of the articles, checks the capital instalment term, and enters the company in the Commercial Registry; issue of a provisional registration record until the definitive certificate is produced.
required_dossiers: Original Documento Privado de Constitución with legalized signatures
Certified copy of the ID of the legal representative
Proof of payment of registration tariffs
Pre-RUT issued by DIAN
If applicable, certificate of tax standing (no deuda) of the NIT
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry returns a 'nota devolutiva' stating deficiencies, the applicant has the statutory correction term (generally 30 working days) to cure them and resubmit; hierarchical remedies (recurso de reposición and apelación) are available under Código de Comercio art. 69, and the registry must decide within 10-15 working days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Definitive commercial registration, issuance of the existence certificate and final RUT
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio and DIAN (integrated issuance)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the Chamber records the S.A.S. in the Commercial Registry and enables online issuance of the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal; the definitive RUT with the final NIT is generated by DIAN and an acknowledgement is sent by e-mail; verify activation of the e-invoicing system (factura electrónica) and, if applicable, resolution of the Régimen Simple; obtain the merchant registry (registro proponente) only if the company will bid on public procurement.
required_dossiers: Chamber registration certificate (original)
Registration resolutions emitted by the Chamber
Legal representative ID with certified signature
DIAN final RUT (copy for employer withholding)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the final RUT omits the CIIU 6201 code or imposes wrong VAT obligations, submit an 'actualización de RUT' through the DIAN virtual office within 10 working days to correct the attributes; the Chamber may re-issue the certificate without additional fee if the discrepancy was its registry error.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Enrollment as employer with social-security administrators and occupational health system
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Administradora de Riesgos Laborales (ARL), EPS and pension administrator, and Caja de Compensación Familiar (PILA platform)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the S.A.S. as an employer in the PILA mechanism; open the obligatory employer account; select the ARL class for software development (low risk, class I), onboard employees with the chosen EPS and pension funds, and file the SG-SST (Sistema de Gestión de Seguridad y Salud en el Trabajo) initial self-assessment in accordance with Resolución 0312 de 2019.
required_dossiers: NIT and RUT final certificate
Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
Employee ID data for affiliations
SG-SST hazard matrix and work plan
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the ARL or pension manager refuses affiliation due to data mismatch, reconcile the payroll registry (Planilla Única) by correcting the type and identifier codes; the company may request a 'certificado de afiliación' after reactivation, and in case of delay, submit a complaint to the Ministerio del Trabajo.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate bank account opening and capitalization evidenced for funding and payment rails
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial banking entity in Colombia (e.g., Bancolombia, Davivienda, BBVA Colombia) and its customer due-diligence officer
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the corporate dossier and the first board resolution to the chosen bank; open a checking or savings account able to receive multicurrency and international SWIFT transfers; deposit the paid share capital and request a bank certification; for recurring USD collections, configure the Stripe integration with a Colombian bank account, noting that ACH Direct (US rail) can only be used with a US-incorporated money-transmission partner or via a currency-conversion route offered by the Colombian bank; the recommended structure is SWIFT-based collection with the S.A.S. NIT documentation, the updated RUT, and a KYC file demonstrating low-risk PropTech software activity.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
NIT and RUT certificates
First board resolution appointing the legal representative and designating bank signatories
ID documents of shareholders, legal representative and signatories
Source-of-funds statement for the paid-up capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank's AML/KYC committee raises enhanced due diligence, provide the share-subscription bank certificates, contractual invoices for first clients, and a written explanation of the PropTech SaaS payment model; if the account remains blocked, escalate through the bank's transactional-risk ombudsman or change to an alternative licensed institution.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: No industrial or manufacturing license applies to ISIC 6201 (software programming). The relevant auxiliary authorities are the municipal planning office (Curaduría Urbana / Planeación Municipal) for the Certificado de Uso de Suelo and the Cuerpo Oficial de Bomberos for fire-safety certification of leased office premises.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: None required for the SaaS activity. For physical premises, the municipality issues the Certificado de Uso de Suelo (land-use clearance) and the Certificado de Bomberos (fire-safety certificate); no separate operational license under Colombian law is imposed on software companies.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA) for projects of national magnitude; for office use, coordination with the Secretaría Distrital de Ambiente (SDA) in Bogotá or the local Corporación Autónoma Regional (CAR).
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - Category 4/Exclusión: software and administrative office activity does not require an EIA or a Plan de Manejo Ambiental (Decreto 1076 de 2015, arts. 2.2.2.3.2.3 and 2.2.2.3.2.4); the company must simply register as a non-hazardous waste generator with the municipal environmental authority and maintain the SST waste-management protocol.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater (sanitary) from offices must respect municipal sewerage discharge requirements under Resolución 0631 de 2015 (e.g., pH 6.0-9.0 units; BOD5 removal above 90% and TSS removal above 90% at the network operator); VOC/air-emission standards are not applicable to code-development activity; electronic waste (UPS, batteries, computer hardware) must be delivered to authorized e-waste recyclers under Resolución 1425 de 2017; non-hazardous paper packaging remains under the municipal waste plan (Acuerdo 575 de 2014 for Bogotá).

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire-safety certificate (Certificado de Bomberos) is mandatory for the leased office; structural load clearance is checked via the land-use certificate and the building's construction/occupancy license (licencia de construcción - uso oficinas); occupational clearance requires implementation and registration of the SG-SST (minimum standards, Resolución 0312 de 2019), ARL affiliation for the company (Risk Class I for software), first-aid and fire warden training, and an ergonomic evaluation of workstations for the office and telework model if applicable.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN); portal: Muisca (transacciones electrónicas), RUT (Registro Único Tributario) and Factura Electrónica services at www.dian.gov.co.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity establishing a Colombian S.A.S. must appoint a legal representative resident in Colombia, obtain a Colombian Tax ID (NIT) through a pre-registration process before DIAN, submit the RUT form, provide notarized constitutional documents (certificate of incorporation and by-laws), evidence the representative's identity/address, and obtain the RUT defintivo. The S.A.S. must also apply for a digital signature certificate and enroll in the electronic invoicing regime (resolución de facturación) before commencing taxable operations.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation (S.A.S. is a Colombian resident corporation subject to corporate income tax on worldwide income; branch/PE activities are source-taxed on a territorial basis).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box election is available. Colombian law permits limited special elections: (i) the Régimen SIMPLE de Tributación (SIMPLO) for small taxpayers not exceeding 100,000 UVT gross income, replacing income tax, VAT, and municipal tax with a single bracket; (ii) irrevocable classification as a 'national corporation' for tax purposes; and (iii) hybrid mismatch elections are not recognized. Foreign tax credit election and CFC rules are mandatory rather than elective.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No general registration threshold. Any entity or individual carrying out taxable acts in Colombia (including remote/external service providers with a tax nexus) must register with DIAN in the RUT. Small taxpayers with gross income below 100,000 UVT (approx. COP 4,732 million for 2024) may optionally adopt the SIMPLE regime, which absorbs VAT and income tax obligations, but they remain VAT-required for invoicing purposes.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic invoicing for all taxpayers. Invoices must be issued electronically through a DIAN-certified technological provider and transmitted in XML to DIAN's Muisca platform in real-time for validation, acceptance, and digital stamping. Each invoice must include the CUFE (Código Único de Facturación Electrónica) or CUDS for exports, a QR code, and the electronic invoice state used. The recipient must accept or reject the invoice within 48 hours. Exports require an 'Export Operator' electronic invoice and prior export registration in the VUCE or customs declaration system.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Qualifying exports of goods and certain services are excluded or exempt from Colombian VAT rather than subject to 0%. For a PropTech/SaaS vendor supplying services from Colombia, zero-rating is available when: (i) the service is rendered to a foreign entity without a permanent establishment in Colombia; (ii) the service is 'exported' in economic terms and the beneficiary has its tax domicile abroad; (iii) the revolution from the contract is effectively used or exploited exclusively outside Colombia; and (iv) the invoice indicates the special 'Export' nature. Digital platforms providing real-estate SaaS to non-resident clients must evidence the off-shore usage and the foreign residence/recipient data in the invoicing system; otherwise the supply is subject to 19% VAT.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Declaración de Exportación / DEX) or authorized equivalent electronic filing
Bill of Lading (BL) or Airway Bill (AWB) evidencing physical movement when goods are involved
Commercial contract and invoice indicating the service destination, scope, and beneficiary
Certificate of payment channeling from a local financial intermediary (Certificado de Canalización de Divisas / Formulario de Declaración de Cambio)
RUT and export registry validity for the exporting entity
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN audits export transactions and may retroactively reinstate the 19% IVA, plus pop-up interest (currently 1.5% per month) and penalty for inaccuracy (sanción por inexactitud) equal to 100% of the outstanding tax difference when the export exemption/zero-rating is unsupported. Fraudulent claims may also trigger criminal tax fraud (defraudación fiscal) penalties and the denial of future export invoices. Additionally, failure to channel export proceeds within the required term by the authorized foreign exchange intermediary may lead to central bank fines and loss of export benefits.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia (Central Bank of Colombia), acting through its Board of Directors (Junta Directiva), is the sole authority for foreign exchange policy, supported by the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia for supervision of IMCs (Intermediarios del Mercado Cambiario). Legal pillars: Ley 9 de 1991 (Estatuto Cambiario, Foreign Exchange Statute), Resolución Externa No. 8 de 2000, and Circular Reglamentaria DCIN-83, as amended. The DIAN also exercises a complementary control function for trade and service flows.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Colombian peso (COP) is partially convertible. Current-account operations (service export revenue, trade payments, profit and dividend remittances) are freely permissible but must be settled through the authorised exchange market (mercado cambiario) via an IMC; no prior authorization is required, yet each flow must be captured in the applicable Declaración de Cambio. Capital-account operations (foreign equity investment into the SAS, cross-border loans, capital repatriation) are liberalised but require mandatory ex-post registration with Banco de la República through Formulario 4 (Declaración de Cambio por Inversiones Internacionales); a registered foreign investment is a strict legal precondition for future dividend remittance and capital repatriation. Profit remittance hurdles: dividends paid to non-resident shareholders are subject to Colombian corporate income tax, dividend withholding tax (generally up to 10% depending on treaty), and, for profits exceeding the applicable taxable amount, an additional remittance surtax; the treasury must evidence payment of such taxes through certificates of tax withholding (certificados de retención) before the bank executes the FX transaction.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: All foreign-currency proceeds derived from the export of PropTech software services must be reintegrated (reintegro): remitted to Colombia and effectively negotiated/sold through the Colombian exchange market via an IMC. The statutory mandatory conversion ratio is effectively 100% of export receipts (no discretionary retention percentage applies). The reintegro term is governed by Resolución Externa No. 8 de 2000 and Circular DCIN-83; the standard maximum window is six (6) months counted from the contractually established collection date/receipt of funds, provided the underlying service contract supports the term, extending beyond the general threshold only under documented commercial reasons accepted by the IMC. Each operation must be declared in the exchange declaration applicable to service exports, supported by invoice, contract, proof of collection, and the platform settlement reports. Alternative structure: the SAS may apply ex ante to Banco de la República for an authorised Cuenta de Compensación (foreign compensation account), allowing the temporary offshore retention of export revenue collected via Stripe or ACH aggregators; balances must comply with the authorised maximum holding period and annual reporting. Failure to reintegro within the statutory term constitutes an infracción cambiaria (exchange violation) with monetary fines calculated on the unrepatriated amount and potential loss of tax evidence.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.additional_exchange_control_notes: Restricted FX availability: the COP is not an internationally fully convertible currency; settlement of USD flows with the IMC occurs at the official TRM (Tasa Representativa del Mercado) rate. The SAS should avoid any unregulated parallel FX settlement or offshore conversion to COP, which would violate the exchange regime. Cash and emolument thresholds: amounts above COP 10 million in cash or large-value wire operations trigger enhanced SAGRILAFT/AML monitoring and may require proof of funds documentation.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (COP) / USD Foreign-Currency Account for inbound investment settlements
Operational Account (COP) / Capital Escrow Account for registered investment
Operational Account (COP) / USD Account for export proceeds reintegro
Operational Account (COP) / Capital Escrow Account for foreign equity

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Restricted / Low for primary treasury operations. Offshore digital EMIs (Wise Business, Airwallex, Mercury, Payoneer) cannot substitute for a Colombian IMC because only authorised local banks and financial corporations may execute foreign-exchange operations, receive Formulario 4/6 exchange declarations, or register foreign investment with Banco de la República. An EMI is compliantly usable only as an intermediate USD aggregation account for Stripe Billing and ACH Direct payouts, provided the account is fully owned by the SAS, is reported under the Cuenta de Compensación regime (if used for export proceeds), and funds are swept to the local IMC within the reintegro term. The EMI must never be used for equity injection, profit remittance, or COP treasury conversion; its existence must be disclosed annually in the exchange information filing to Banco de la República and in the applicable DIAN exogenous information. Feasibility rating: Medium as a pass-through rail; Low as a treasury spine.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is effectively mandatory at initial onboarding. Banks require the legal representative of the SAS (or a person holding a notarised, apostilled power of attorney) to attend an in-person interview at the branch, typically in Bogotá or Medellín; remote opening is rarely permitted for entities with non-resident beneficial owners, given Colombian AML practice as set out in the Circular Básica Jurídica and SAGRILAFT standards. Required documents: current Cámara de Comercio certificate (issued within the last 30 days), RUT (Registro Único Tributario), certified corporate by-laws, board/shareholders minutes appointing the legal representative (apostilled and translated if executed abroad), UBO declaration, valid passport or cédula of the FR, source-of-funds letters for shareholders, proof of the PropTech platform business model, and tax-residency certificates of non-resident owners. Realistic onboarding timeline: 2-4 weeks from interview to full activation of FX functionality.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident ultimate beneficial owners structured through a multi-tier holding chain, creating opacity in ownership for SAGRILAFT.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete UBO ownership chart; apostilled constitutional documents for each holding tier; share register and transfer ledger; sworn source-of-wealth and source-of-funds statements of ultimate investors; bank reference letters from the shareholders home institution; CRS/FATCA self-certifications; consolidated business plan and projected P&L evidencing genuine commercial activity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-velocity micro-payment software receipts from third-party processor rails (Stripe Billing, ACH Direct), perceived as fragmented or as aggregating third-party funds.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Platform subscription and SaaS master agreements; Stripe merchant onboarding record; granular settlement and payout reports; sample customer invoices; a treasury memorandum classifying each rail as Colombian export of services under the exchange regime; letters from payment processors confirming that funds represent the SAS's own receivables.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Multiple-currency inflows from diverse Latin American cloud customers, creating a mismatch with the nominal COP operational account and raising informal-remittance flags.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Historical transaction reports (settlement TPVs) with FX conversion detail; documented payment waterfall from Stripe/ACH to USD account to IMC reintegro; proof of previous reintegro operations through the IMC; revenue recognition schedules and contract register; local treasury forecast of expected EUR/USD/COP tickets.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Detection of an offshore USD account with an EMI or fintech aggregator in the corporate banking history or CV.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Banco de la República authorisation for the Cuenta de Compensación (or written legal analysis of the exemption); monthly USD statements demonstrating pass-through-only usage; copies of annual exchange information declarations; internal policy manual limiting the offshore account balance and holding period to the statutory reintegro window.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant sequence for foreign equity injection into the Colombian SAS: (1) the foreign investor transmits USD or other foreign currency by SWIFT MT103 to the SAS's USD account held at the local IMC, inserting the exchange purpose code for international investment in field 72/70 rather than a generic goods or service code; (2) on the settlement business day the IMC captures and files Formulario 4 (Declaración de Cambio por Inversiones Internacionales) with Banco de la República, identifying the transaction as direct foreign investment (inversión directa), the NIT of the SAS, and the subscribed capital; (3) the IMC converts the funds at the official TRM and credits the COP operational account; (4) Banco de la República issues the investment registration record in the name of the SAS, which becomes the legal anchor for future dividend and capital remittances. The treasury must archive the MT103, the FX contract/ticket, and the Formulario 4 acceptance, and reconcile the registration with the equity section of the financial statements. For capital injections above USD 1 million the bank will require a written use-of-proceeds statement and may run enhanced sanctions and negative-news screens; for shareholder loans above statutory thresholds, an external indebtedness registration (Formulario 5) would be required instead of Formulario 4. Capital contributions below the local threshold do not require prior authorisation, but never allow the wire to arrive without pre-agreed purpose codes, as re-remediation is materially slower.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For outbound trade, software license fees, cloud infrastructure, marketing services, and cross-border contractor payments: the standard clearing rail is a clean SWIFT MT103 issued from the SAS's COP account, with the IMC purchasing foreign currency and filing the exchange declaration for service imports (Formulario 6/Giros al Exterior). Supporting evidence: commercial contract, vendor invoice, and where the annual threshold applies, the official DIAN declaration of service imports to substantiate tax deductibility. For physical PropTech hardware, beacons, or point-of-sale devices, the recommended rail is a sight Commercial Letter of Credit (confirmed or unconfirmed) issued by the Colombian bank's trade desk on documents-against-payment terms, accompanied by the DIAN goods import declaration; the LC operation also triggers the exchange declaration by the IMC. Attention: all disbursements linked to the export service chain should retain the full MT103 trail, because Colombian tax and exchange auditors cross-match outbound spending to the reintegro of export receivables. International payroll for foreign contractors may be executed through the same MT103 route or via a payroll-specialist EMI, but the local bank still expects the exchange declaration. Statutory minimis: service imports below the threshold may proceed under general rules, yet treasury policy should formalise every operation with the bank's granted FX form.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: COP/USD deliverable FX forwards (Forwards) with the Colombian IMC: authorised solely to hedge genuine commercial exposures such as USD-denominated SaaS receivables, future equity injections, and dividend remittance obligations; the hedge documentation must reference the underlying invoicing/settlement reports and match the reintegro or remittance horizon; no naked speculative forward positions are permitted for residents.

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on USD/COP: usable in the offshore market and mirrorable through Colombian banks where the resident has a demonstrable underlying currency exposure; the operation must satisfy Banco de la República's risk-hedging conditions and be reported by the IMC; NDFs cannot be used to avoid mandatory reintegro of export proceeds.

Cross-currency swaps (CCS) COP/USD: suitable for hedging medium-term intercompany shareholder loans, dividend flows, or future capital repatriation; must be transacted through an IMC, with both the FX rate and interest legs included in the relevant exchange declaration; economic substance documentation and board approval are required.

Listed COP/USD futures traded on the Colombian derivatives exchange (Derivex/BVC) and cleared through a central counterparty: appropriate for systematic quarterly hedging of recurring Stripe and ACH receivable flows across 3-12 month tenors; margin variation payments must be forecast in the COP liquidity plan; futures are explicitly recognised under Colombian exchange regulations as permitted hedging tools when linked to real exposure.

FX options and zero-cost collars with authorised IMC counterparties: permissible for protection against abrupt TRM depreciation on committed cross-border disbursements or when protecting the COP value of the investment; premiums must be paid through the IMC and the underlying operational exposure evidenced at inception.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Commercial Registration Renewal (Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the company's registered domicile
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually between 1 January and 31 March for calendar-year entities
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal triggers late-filing fines and default interest imposed by the Cámara de Comercio; continued non-renewal may lead to cancellation of the commercial registration and administrative strike-off of the S.A.S.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Financial Statements Deposit (Depósito de Estados Financieros, Informe de Gestión y Dictamen del Revisor Fiscal si aplica)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No later than 31 March for a 31 December fiscal year-end; within three months after the close of the fiscal year for other year-ends
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to deposit blocks registration of subsequent corporate acts and documents; the Superintendencia de Sociedades may impose administrative fines, and the financial statements are not legally opposable against third parties. Persistent noncompliance may support administrative dissolution proceedings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Ultimate Beneficial Owner Declaration (Declaración Anual de Beneficiarios Finales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales) – Beneficial Owner Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the DIAN-assigned calendar date based on the last digit of the taxpayer's NIT; an updated declaration is required within the separately prescribed DIAN window after any material shareholding change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Inaccurate, incomplete, or late filings expose the S.A.S. and its legal representative to fines under Colombian tax procedure; unresolved noncompliance may restrict corporate actions, expense deductibility, and notarial registration of transactions.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A Colombian S.A.S. must retain a legally certified revisor fiscal where, at the prior fiscal year-end, it exceeds any of the following statutory thresholds: total assets above 5,000 monthly statutory minimum wages (SMMLV), gross income above 3,000 SMMLV, or a workforce above 200 employees. Independent statutory audit is also mandatory if required by the incorporation by-laws, by the Superintendencia de Sociedades, or by sector-specific regulation.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as adopted in Colombia (NIIF) under Law 1314 of 2009; small and mid-size entities that qualify as Group 2 apply NIIF para PYMES (IFRS for SMEs). Financial statements are prepared to 31 December, presented in COP, and include comparative prior-year information.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: All share transfers must be recorded in the Register of Members before voting and dividend rights are exercisable by the transferee. Annually, the S.A.S. must confirm to DIAN the full natural-person beneficial ownership chain for every direct or indirect owner at or above the 5% threshold of capital, voting rights, profit participation, or control. The annual confirmation is due even if no share transfer occurred; if transfers ocurridos occurred during the year, the declaration must reconcile prior and new beneficial owners and be supported by updated share transfer instruments.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Libro de Registro de Accionistas)
Register of Directors and Officers (as maintained for corporate governance and Chamber filings)
Minute Book of Shareholders' Meetings (Libro de Actas de Asamblea)
Minute Book of Board of Directors' Meetings (Libro de Actas de Junta Directiva, when a board is constituted)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 250 – USD 800 per annum for a registered commercial domicile and local corporate agent service, excluding Chamber tariffs and notarial costs
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,500 – USD 7,500 per annum for an NIIF-compliant statutory audit of a small-to-mid-market PropTech S.A.S., subject to structure and consolidated group requirements

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 35% (general corporate income tax rate for taxable years 2023 onward under Law 2277/2022)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Deduction for payroll-based ICT/software research as intangible; potential 10-year income tax exemption for new 'naranja' (orange economy) ventures if eligible; standard deductions for operating expenses, salaries, depreciation, amortization, and software platform costs. No statutory lower effective CIT rate for standard PropTech SaaS operations outside free trade zones.
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_limit_years: Unlimited carryforward available, but annual offset of prior-year tax losses is limited to 25% of current-year net taxable income (Article 147 ET).
